scene: You step off the yellow school bus onto the museum's sprawling roof.
picture: Side-view rooftop scene along a flat tile floor. Far left sits a wooden sandpit with fossil bones poking out. Beside it, the yellow school bus is parked. The boy stands left of centre holding his skateboard. In the centre, a mechanical robotic raptor skeleton clicks its jaws. Far right sits a bright glass gift shop door.
